title: Transfinite Daugavet property
summary: We extend the Daugavet property and a perfect version of it to transfinite cardinals in order to distinguish between spaces with the ordinary Daugavet property by some kind of complexity (topological, density\ldots), providing a number of examples and results. First, we characterise the transfinite Daugavet $C(K)$ spaces in terms of a cardinal index $\mathfrak r(K)$, which generalises the notion of the reaping number of a Boolean algebra.
